note: 入库字典。ISO 11179：表=对象类，字段=特性，codes=值域。导航七组与页签是规范面，不是 OOP 属性/行为。一行是命名个体，一包是一个版本文档。

store.pkPolicy: Static relational key = (package_id, version, type, id); canonical IRI must be unique within package/version. Resolve semantic identity using identity-registry.json and identity.py; never derive every IRI as base#id.

identityPolicy.sourceIri: Preserve an explicit source iri exactly; this takes precedence over fallback naming, including Agent namespace IRIs.
identityPolicy.classWithoutIri: https://local.ontology/coast-raid-k#<URI-encoded-class-id>; do not introduce a Class# or Type# namespace.
identityPolicy.individualWithoutIri: https://local.ontology/coast-raid-k#individual/<URI-encoded-type>/<URI-encoded-id>; type and id are separate encoded path segments.
identityPolicy.legacyAlias: Historical base#id aliases are resolved only when unique. Ambiguous aliases return all canonical candidates; they never select the first match. An exact canonical IRI match takes precedence over alias lookup.
identityPolicy.shortId: A short id is a display and compatibility key, not a globally unique semantic identity.
identityPolicy.scope: Static knowledge package projection; runtime run-scoped records are held separately and are not flattened into this static key.
